column3: Setup: Use the update_request_rejection testdrive - it supplies journal_2 ('Update Request Rejection - Reject Then Resubmit <run_seed>'), an in-DOAJ journal owned by the testdrive's publisher account, which already has one Update Request in its history, already Rejected (titled '...superseded UR <run_seed>'). This lets the test focus on its one live (resubmitted) Update Request, rather than needing two live submissions back-to-back on the same journal within DOAJ's update-request submission cooldown. OR provide those yourself.

Setup: Important: the testdrive page tears down its data as soon as you navigate away from it. Log in and run the test in a separate browser tab/window, leaving the testdrive tab open until you have finished.
Confirm the testdrive's superseded, already-Rejected Update Request for journal_2 is visible via the admin area search (filter by Rejected)

column4: The record contains the value "Originally For: [journal_2 id]"

column3: Log in as the publisher account from the testdrive and create another Update Request for journal_2 - this is the test's one live submission.  Make a change that will be fairly easy to review from the ToC (e.g. the APC amount) AND which is different from the superseded update request.  Take a note of the Journal's ToC URL
Locate the new Update Request created in the previous step in the admin search area

column4: The Journal page has been updated with the new information from the Update Request (e.g the updated APC amount)

column3: Search for the Journal's ISSN in the admin journal search

column4: There is only one Journal published in DOAJ with that ISSN

column3: Find the accepted application via the admin search (e.g. filter by Accepted and sort by last updated most recent first)
